description: Shared field-type rejections, the unsupported-field rejection (Go now mirrors Python's allowlist), and the settings PUT body. Empty-field and confirm-gate text diverge (see report).

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This updates account-wide settings. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects a maintenance policy the account does not offer
cases.expect_error: maintenance_policy must be one of: linode/migrate, linode/power_off_on

cases.name: rejects an interface default the account does not offer
cases.expect_error: interfaces_for_new_linodes must be one of: legacy_config_only, legacy_config_default_but_linode_allowed, linode_default_but_legacy_config_allowed, linode_only
